checks.pythia_duplicates_note: 190,584 PYTHIA images (7.2% of 2,635,582) are exact copies of an image in another file: pairs only (no image occurs 3 times), 955 files involved, 295-496 copies per file, in shuffled order (e.g. 397 events of file 1954 reappear in file 2448 under other event numbers; the same number in only 194 pairs), never within one file. One image of each pair is kept (the lower sample index). Among the non-identical events of two such file pairs no near-copy (same leading tower, total energy within 0.1%) was found. JEWEL: no duplicate; no image is shared between the domains.

norm.fitted_on: train_pythia + train_jewel canvases, every pixel of the 16 x 16 canvas (the closure procedure)

selection: leading R = 0.4 cone (axis = tower of largest cone sum, phi periodic) >= 10.0 GeV, axis rows 4-19 (9 x 9 window inside the acceptance); one jet per parent
canvas: 16 x 16, 9 x 9 window at 4..12, R = 0.4 cone towers only (53), tower E_T in GeV, clipped at 0
crop_excludes: all energy outside the R = 0.4 cone around the leading axis: wide-angle radiation, out-of-cone medium-induced radiation and recoil energy, the recoiling jet, the underlying event
towers of the 9 x 9 window outside the cone (dR > 0.4)
everything beyond |eta| < 1.1 (the image), and particles the images do not hold
splits_by: parent key = file x 10^6 + event, one jet per parent; one fixed permutation per domain
excluded: the 20000 JEWEL parents of pairs_jewel_n20000_seed0.npz (the subtraction study's JEWEL evaluation)

provenance.pythia: train/signal.h5 = type11_run19_jet30_pythia_noNoise_allCentrality (sPHENIX-style production naming: sample type 11, "jet30", run 19, no noise); generator version, tune, the definition of the jet30 requirement and the detector simulation are not recorded with the data
provenance.jewel: Zenodo record 17594612, jewel_jet30.tar.gz: one ROOT TH2D per event (24 x 64, eta -1.1..1.1, phi 0..2 pi), no generator record, seeds, version or medium parameters; the mixed test sample is named type4_hijing_plus_jewel_jet30_40_50 (meaning of 40_50 not documented); recoil treatment unknown
provenance.common: both samples share the smallest tower value (1.1e-4 GeV) and the low quantiles of the tower spectrum, which suggests the same tower-level pipeline; not documented
differences_can_include: generator differences (JEWEL runs PYTHIA 6 for the hard process; the PYTHIA sample is presumably PYTHIA 8; tunes, underlying event)
generator-level jet requirements of each sample
the common >= 10 GeV leading-cone selection acting on different spectra
